panel.title: Business-day calendar
panel.hint: Saturday, holidays and city anniversaries that the business-day delivery deadline counts.
panel.forbidden: You do not have permission to view the business-day calendar.

notice.routing: The routing closes the city's customers on the dates generated by this rule (through {{year}}); national and state holidays do not close customers in the routing; the delivery deadline per contractor counts all of them.
notice.adopted: This date is now yours and survives the rule's deletion: the rule no longer generates it.
notice.typedKept_one: {{count}} typed date on the old day remains in force.
notice.typedKept_other: {{count}} typed dates on the old day remain in force.

saturday.title: Saturday
saturday.label: Saturday is a business day
saturday.hint: When on, the business-day deadline counts Saturday. Sunday never counts.

municipal.title: Municipal holidays
municipal.hint: Register the city's holiday or anniversary. "Every year" creates a rule that the system generates for the coming years by itself; "This date only" applies once.

form.cityLoadError: Could not load the cities. Type the IBGE code.
form.lockedHint: The city and the recurrence cannot be edited: to change them, delete and register again.
form.lockedHintDate: City and date cannot be edited: to change them, delete and register again.

horizon.notice: Some rules have dates generated only through {{year}}: after that the routing stops closing those cities' customers.
horizon.none: No new date: the rules were already complete.

state.title: State holidays
state.hint: Applies to every city in the state. A state holiday counts in the delivery deadline but does not close customers in the routing.

form.lockedHint: The state and the recurrence cannot be edited: to change them, delete and register again.

fieldErrors.dayNotInMonth: This day does not exist in that month.

cityIbgeCode.invalid: Enter the city's IBGE code, with seven digits.

holidayOn.invalid: This date does not exist in the calendar.

rule.title: Delete the rule “{{name}}”?
rule.body: The dates it generated (through {{year}}) stop applying to the routing.

date.title: Delete the date “{{name}}”?
date.body: The date stops applying to the routing and to the delivery deadline.

state.title: Delete the state holiday “{{name}}”?
state.body: The holiday stops counting in the delivery deadline of every city in the state.

dialog.typedKept_one: {{count}} typed date on this day remains in force.
dialog.typedKept_other: {{count}} typed dates on this day remain in force.
